P1: The search covered only the last 12 days (evaluated 12 days ago to now) and its status is partial, so the 30-day window was not fully searched. The absence of refunds to other countries cannot be established for days 13-30. Cannot tell.

P2: The link was effective at 09:40 Monday, before the 10:00 scoring, but it was learned at 15:00 Monday. The system could not have known about it at 10:00, so the evidence was not available to the check. The check did not miss available evidence. Answer: No.

P3: A rise from 1% to 6% is a sixfold jump in refund rate in one week. Together with the question of whether M is refunding to its own cards, this warrants review. Yes.

RESULT PN-029 | P1: Cannot tell | P2: No | P3: Yes
